primaryRawText:
V850 SFX GOLD
MPY-8501-SFHAGV
MAKE IT MINI
The V SFX Gold delivers the high quality experience you’ve
come to expect from the V series in SFX form factor. Enjoy
the same great features with 80 Plus Gold efficiency, full-
modular cabling, an FDB fan, 16AWG PCIe high efficiency
cables, and a 10 year warranty. But now you can have it in a
mini-ITX case. With the V SFX Gold, the V series is now viable
for cases ranging from mini-ITX all the way up through E-
ATX systems. And with the included bracket this unit is
compatible with all of them.
FEATURES SPECIFICATIONS
SFX Form Factor : This unit is compatible with all SFX cases and
suitable for mini-ITX system builds.
SFX-to-ATX Bracket : The included bracket allows users to install
this unit securely in traditional ATX cases.
80 PLUS Gold Certified : This certification guarantees a typical
efficiency of 90% under normal operating conditions.
Quiet FDB Fan : The 92mm FDB fan delivers effective, quiet, and
efficient cooling.
Full-Modular Cabling : Modular cables reduce clutter, increase
airflow, and improve overall efficiency and thermal performance.
10 Year Warranty : This unit comes with a standard limited
manufacturing warranty of 10 years from the date of purchase.
